zh-CN.title: 群语音通话
items: 普通群聊支持发起和主动加入多人语音通话，发起人离开后其他成员可以继续聊。
永久 VIP 的语音通话额度提升至每周 30 分钟，私聊和群聊共用，群通话按个人参会时长计费。

en.title: Group voice calls
items: Start or join a group voice call. Other members can keep talking after the host leaves.
Permanent VIPs get 30 minutes a week across direct and group calls. Group calls count only the time you participate.
